title: Visitor of Heavenly Secrets
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the messenger took that step, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—he finally saw the face obscured by mist, and that aura was identical to the 49th chess piece awakened in Volume Five.

text.content: The moment the Fourth Page's light faded completely, Chen Ji's True Qi suddenly stagnated. It was a sensation he had never experienced—as if an invisible pair of eyes was piercing through the countless layers of the Void, staring fixedly at the depths of his soul. A familiar fluctuation surged like a tide, carrying the unique aura of his missing sister Chen Nian, yet intertwined with a strange distortion.

dialogue.content: (Inner turmoil hidden beneath a calm facade) Chen Nian... where exactly are you? Why does your aura appear here?

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open. The符文 on the Tianji Record Fragment still trembled faintly. However, in the next instant, his expression froze—before the cave dwelling's entrance, a figure had somehow appeared. Silver mist gently enveloped the person, their features blurred as if belonging to another world entirely. An ancient, profound aura emanated from them, like an eternal star that had existed since time immemorial.

dialogue.content: (Eyes turning icy cold, hand already secretly gripping the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve) Impressive technique, to enter my humble dwelling without a sound. Friend or foe?

text.content: A light laugh drifted from within the silver mist, mild yet carrying bone-deep chill: "Chen Ji, servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, appearing cowardly and incompetent on the surface while secretly orchestrating schemes across the world. Your so-called 'feigned death' escape technique is nothing more than拙劣戏法 in the eyes of the Tianji Pavilion."

dialogue.content: (Pupils slightly dilating, yet a playful smile forming on his face) Oh? The Tianji Pavilion... interesting. I thought it was merely a mortal legend. Unexpected that someone would dare claim the ability to peer into heavenly secrets. What brings you here today?

text.content: The messenger stepped forward. The silver mist rippled slightly as their voice carried no trace of emotion: "The Tianji Pavilion knows all your schemes—your hidden pieces within the Tianqing Sect, your dealings with the Holy Sect's demon path, and the whereabouts of your sister Chen Nian. We've come only to discuss a transaction."

dialogue.content: (Inwardly掀起惊涛骇浪, yet appearing even more languidly as he leaned against the stone couch) A transaction? Interesting. However, I'm curious—why would an eminent existence like the Tianji Pavilion trouble itself over a man who has already 'died'?

text.content: The messenger raised their hand. A jade slip, emanating cold,幽冷光芒, materialized from thin air: "This contains the location of the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record, along with all conditions required to activate it. In exchange—you must agree to one instance of unconditional obedience to the Tianji Pavilion. Whenever and wherever we call, you must act."

dialogue.content: (Smile turning colder) Unconditional obedience? That's quite an appetite you have there. What if you order me to my death—should I comply without question?

text.content: At that moment, Chen Ji's gaze suddenly sharpened. He noticed that the silver mist surrounding the messenger briefly散开 at a certain instant, revealing a faint mark on their right wrist—a opened eye, its pupil flickering with light similar to the Tianji Record符文, yet unmistakably more ancient.

dialogue.content: (Eyes suddenly turning razor-sharp, inner emotions churning) The aura when the 49th chess piece awakened... it was exactly like this! Why do you carry such a thing upon your person?

text.content: The messenger seemed to notice Chen Ji's change in gaze, smiling faintly: "You are indeed perceptive. Correct, there is indeed a connection between the Tianji Pavilion and the so-called 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets.' But today is not the time to discuss this—Chen Ji, you only need to answer me: this transaction, do you accept or not?"

choice.prompt: The Tianji Pavilion's proposal was riddled with traps, but the Fourth Page's location was indeed tempting. Chen Ji needed to make a choice:

choices.description: First obtain the Fourth Page intelligence. As for unconditional obedience—that's something to figure out later.
choices.visible_cost: Lose one instance of autonomous decision-making
choices.risk_hint: Unconditional obedience could be a lethal trap

dialogue.content: (After a long pause, raising his eyes to直视 the messenger) Very well, I accept. However—unconditional obedience must have a time limit. I refuse to sell my life to an unknown entity.

text.content: The messenger seemed to have anticipated this, the silver mist rippling slightly: "A time limit? Three months. Within these three months, we will only invoke this once. The jade slip is yours—but remember, if you breach the agreement, the consequences are not something you can bear." With that, the jade slip floated before Chen Ji.

choices.description: A clause like unconditional obedience is utterly outrageous. I'd rather forgo the intelligence than agree to such terms.
choices.visible_cost: Lose leads to the Fourth Page intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Tianji Pavilion's displeasure

dialogue.content: (Smile turning cold, slowly rising) Unconditional obedience? You mistake me for a naive child? No one under heaven or earth would agree to such terms.

text.content: The messenger fell silent for a moment. A sigh drifted from within the silver mist: "Regrettable... but this debt, the Tianji Pavilion will remember. Chen Ji, I hope you won't regret today's choice." As the voice faded, the messenger's figure had already begun to gradually dissipate.

choices.description: Avoid direct answer, first extract more intelligence regarding the relationship between the Tianji Pavilion and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

dialogue.content: (A playful smile, unhurriedly pouring himself a cup of tea) You mentioned a connection to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... what kind of connection might that be? I'm quite curious—are you of the same faction, or... a competitive relationship?

text.content: The messenger's expression shifted subtly, the silver mist波动得更加剧烈: "You are clever—cleverer than I anticipated. But some things are not for you to touch at your current level—knowing too much will bring you no benefit."

The instant Chen Ji took the jade slip, a bone-chilling aura surged into his mind. Within the jade slip materialized a blurry scene: a mountain range shrouded in black mist, an ancient altar atop the peak, and upon the altar lay a fragmented stone tablet—its flowing patterns identical to the符文 on the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content: (Inner emotions churning, yet maintaining a facade of composure) Xuantian Forbidden Land... so you actually know the Fourth Page is there.

text.content: Just as the messenger was about to speak, Chen Ji suddenly raised his hand to interrupt: "Wait. Before you leave, I have one more question—you said the Eye of Heavenly Secrets has one of 'our people' standing behind it. What exactly does that sentence mean?"

dialogue.content: (A low,低沉的笑声 drifted from the silver mist) Chen Ji, you believed the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was the ultimate enemy? How naive. It is merely a chess piece we have positioned in this world—as is the Tianji Record itself. Everything you have experienced lies within an even higher-level chess game.

text.content: These words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said—the "Tianji Record is merely one of the chess pieces the Heavenly Dao's will has positioned in this world." Now it seemed, even the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was merely a chess piece in an even grander game. So then—who was the true Chess Player?

dialogue.content: (Forcefully suppressing the惊天骇浪 in his heart, a cold smile forming on his face) Interesting... so the 'final boss' I thought I was facing is merely another's plaything. Rest assured, this debt I will remember. When I someday overturn this chessboard, I hope the Tianji Pavilion won't hide from meeting me.

text.content: The messenger offered no response, leaving only one sentence before completely dissipating: "Chen Ji, you are more dangerous than any of the previous prophetic ones. That is why we approached you. The three-month deadline—I hope you won't disappoint us—and more importantly, I hope you are still alive at that time." The silver mist thoroughly dissipated, leaving only Chen Ji alone in the cave dwelling, and the jade slip in his hand emanating cold,幽冷光芒.

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the jade slip in his palm. His mind raced at lightning speed. Tianji Pavilion, the Fourth Page, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, his sister Chen Nian... all clues pointed in the same direction—Xuantian Forbidden Land. At this moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a faint warmth, as if responding to something. He raised his head, his gaze穿透ing the cave dwelling's禁制, gazing toward that distant mountain range shrouded in black mist.

dialogue.content: (Within the First Page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's残魂 flickered slightly, a voice echoing in Chen Ji's mind) Boy, you've gotten yourself into serious trouble. The Tianji Pavilion... those are existences that even the Heavenly Dao's will must regard with caution. However, since you've already accepted this transaction, there's no turning back.

text.content: Chen Ji offered no answer. He merely tucked the jade slip into his breast pocket, closed his eyes. Tianji Pavilion, three months of unconditional obedience, Xuantian Forbidden Land... and that aura identical to when the 49th chess piece awakened. All the mysteries intertwined, forming a colossal web he had never witnessed. And he—was already entangled within it.

After a long while, Chen Ji opened his eyes. The corner of his mouth curved into ameaningful弧度: "Tianji Pavilion... interesting. Since you wish to play, I shall play this game to the very end. Only I wonder—what expression will the Chess Players make when they discover their chess pieces no longer obey?" With that, he closed his eyes once more, continuing his meditation as if nothing had transpired.

In the instant the Fourth Page's light faded, Chen Ji sensed the familiar aura emanating from the depths—that was the unique fluctuation belonging to his missing sister Chen Nian. And now, he finally knew her direction: Xuantian Forbidden Land. However, blocking the path ahead was not merely the Forbidden Land's myriad dangers, but also the three-month deadline brought by that transaction, and the Tianji Pavilion's unfathomable machinations.
